Prioritize correctness over decorative detail. Title: “Prompt、Context、Harness 各管什么”. Three horizontal pastel lanes with a left category tab and a simple illustrated example to the right. Mint lane “Prompt” with subtitle “明确判断规则”: document icon “发布日 ≠ 生效日” → outlined proposal note “分别核对字段”. Blue lane “Context” with subtitle “提供有效证据”: two source cards “有效公告 v2” and “待核验记录 r7”, both arrows into a reading tray “本轮输入”; a small grey separate card “旧公告 v1” labeled “仅作历史”. Lavender lane “Harness” with subtitle “控制执行与验收”: “提案” → “检查许可” → “创建工单” → “回读验收”. Under lanes a small shared caption “三种职责相互配合”. Do not portray these as three products or a mandatory chronological upgrade path.
illustrations.alt: Prompt 规定怎样判断字段，Context 提供有效公告与待核验记录，Harness 检查许可、执行创建并回读验收。
illustrations.caption: 职责图解｜以资料核验为例；发布日与生效日是不同字段，三种职责共同完成任务。

illustrations.purpose: Mini Harness 的八项职责如何落到两个进程
illustrations.prompt: Create an original educational infographic for a Chinese engineering article. Style reference: white paper, hand-drawn black ink outlines, rounded boxes, gentle mint / powder blue / lavender / pale yellow marker fills, large friendly hand-lettered headings, tiny simple line icons, generous whitespace. Use the EXACT short labels specified below, no extra paragraphs or invented claims. Colored badges and arrow directions have semantic meaning. One clear concept per image. Prioritize correctness over decorative detail. Title “Mini Harness 怎样组装”. Draw two clearly bounded areas. Left, large pastel blue area labeled “运行器进程”: eight? exactly SEVEN rounded modules inside, numbers as given: “1 任务契约”, “2 上下文”, “3 模型适配”, “4 运行控制”, “5 执行策略”, “6 工具客户端”, “8 结果验收”. Arrange module 4 central, 1 feeds 4, 4 sends request to 2 then 3 returns “提案” to 4. Main action from 4 → 5 → 6. Right, smaller mint area labeled “工具服务进程” with “查询 / 创建” block. Bidirectional connection 6 ↔ query/create labeled “MCP stdio”. Lower part shows two separate database cylinders grouped under “7 状态存储”: beneath left “Runs：意图与进度”, beneath right “Tickets：工单与操作键”. Connect module 4 bidirectionally to Runs, query/create bidirectionally to Tickets. Module 8 receives “查询结果” from client 6 and writes “验收结论” to Runs. No direct permission arrow from model to tool server. Small footer “八项职责，不必拆成八个服务”. Use large short text, legible spaced routing, no tangled lines. This is a teaching implementation, not a generic distributed deployment.
illustrations.alt: Mini Harness 的运行器接收模型提案，经策略检查后通过 MCP 调用工具服务；Runs 保存意图与进度，Tickets 保存工单与操作键，查询结果交给验收器。
illustrations.caption: 装配图解｜按职责阅读编号；运行器与工具服务是两个进程，两份数据库分别记录运行和业务事实。

Lane A mint “A 显式循环”: Python loop icon ↔ database “运行状态”; beneath loop separate “业务工具”. Tradeoffs “优点：轻、易追踪” and “代价：自行维护恢复”. illustrations.purpose: 工单已创建但响应丢失时，按原键查询
illustrations.prompt: Create an original educational infographic for a Chinese engineering article. Use the EXACT short labels specified below, no extra paragraphs or invented claims. Colored badges and arrow directions have semantic meaning. One clear concept per image. Prioritize correctness over decorative detail. Title “响应丢了，工单可能已经存在”. Four large panels in a 2×2 reading layout with clear numbered circles and arrows 1→2→3→4. Panel 1 mint “1 保存意图”: runner notebook “操作键 K” sending “创建 K” to business server. Panel 2 blue “2 提交成功，响应丢失”: database contains ONE ticket “工单 T · 键 K”; returning arrow towards runner is crossed with a small orange X labeled “响应丢失”. Panel 3 lavender “3 恢复后按原键查询”: runner notebook still “操作键 K” → server magnifier “查询 K”; no create arrow. Panel 4 yellow “4 回读字段，确认完成”: ONE ticket “工单 T” with checklist “目标一致” “结果已保存”. Footer “客户端状态：未知 → 查询确认” and small separate “前提：服务端将操作键与工单原子提交，并约束键唯一”. Make message loss distinct from failed business write. Do not imply checkpoint alone prevents duplicate writes. Large simple text; this is one illustrated successful-reconciliation path.
illustrations.revision_prompt: Edit this existing infographic. Preserve its style, title, exact four numbered panels, pastel colors and footer. Correct only logical arrows and the last panel. REMOVE ALL arrows in the gutters between the four panels; readers use numbers 1,2,3,4 in reading order, no cross-panel arrows at all. In panel 4 REMOVE the server-to-database rightward yellow arrow and REMOVE the database cylinder. Instead draw a server on the RIGHT returning a small ticket document “工单 T” with a LEFTWARD arrow labeled “返回已有工单” to the runner laptop on the LEFT. Put a separate checklist next to the laptop labeled “核对目标” and “保存验收结果”. This is a READ response and client-side verification; no write/create arrow in panel 4. Panels 1,2,3 and footers stay as they are. All text large readable Chinese, no new claims.
illustrations.alt: 服务端创建工单 T 后丢失响应。客户端恢复时保留操作键 K，按 K 查询已有工单，核对目标并保存验收结果，不再次创建。
illustrations.caption: 恢复图解｜对应服务端提交后丢响应这一条路径。K 是原操作键，T 是已经存在的工单。

illustrations.alt: 查询当前附近的办公地点时，上海旧住址仅作历史，其他用户的无权记录被过滤；杭州当前住址经检索、去重和预算检查后，连同来源与时间进入上下文。
illustrations.caption: 记忆图解｜沿用开篇的搬家例子。先按当前身份与查询时间过滤，再比较相关性；历史事实仍可保留。

illustrations.purpose: 同一组三次运行，至少一次成功与全部成功判断不同
illustrations.prompt: Create an original educational infographic for a Chinese engineering article. Style reference: white paper, hand-drawn black ink outlines, rounded boxes, gentle mint / powder blue / lavender / pale yellow marker fills, large friendly hand-lettered headings, tiny simple line icons, generous whitespace. Similar visual language to the supplied cache explainer examples, but original composition and content. No logos, watermarks, website names, fake UI, gradients or photorealism. Use the EXACT short labels specified below, no extra paragraphs or invented claims. Colored badges and arrow directions have semantic meaning. One clear concept per image. Prioritize correctness over decorative detail. Title “至少成功一次 ≠ 每次都成功”. Upper panel “同一月报任务，独立运行三次” with three equal cards: “第 1 次” green check “8 月正确”; “第 2 次” green check “8 月正确”; “第 3 次” coral X “误用了 7 月”. Clarify header small “示意结果”. Lower panel two equal side-by-side cards. Blue left “pass@3” subtitle “三次中至少一次成功” with green check and “这组满足”. Lavender right “pass^3” subtitle “三次全部成功” with coral X and “这组不满足”. Footer “一组示例说明判定条件，不是整体评测得分”. Do not include percentages, estimated numeric benchmark values, or independence probability formula. Here independent means separate runs, do not assert statistical independence; therefore better use exact top label “同一月报任务，运行三次” instead of independent phrase.
illustrations.alt: 同一月报任务三次运行中，前两次正确使用八月数据，第三次误用七月。它满足三次至少一次成功的条件，不满足三次全部成功的条件。
illustrations.caption: 指标图解｜同一组三次示意结果，对应至少一次成功与全部成功两种判定；整体指标仍需按任务集计算。
